# M2 synthetic fixtures

a.pdf (2 pages), b.pdf (3 pages) and c.pdf (1 page) are generated by tests/combine.test.ts. They cover searchable text, vector marks, A4/Letter, nonzero MediaBox, CropBox, rotations and UserUnit. No personal material is included.

benchmark-1.pdf through benchmark-5.pdf are generated by scripts/generate-combine-benchmark.mts. Each has 20 pages and exactly 4 MiB. Padding is page-referenced PDF comments, so the input size is real but does not represent complex scanned images. The SHA-256 manifest records these synthetic benchmark files. The 100-page performance threshold is measured after two warmups and over twenty samples; it is not a promise for all PDFs.
